S11.title: Periodic sweep and explicit manual command to find unreferenced chunks, respect safety margins, unlink blob files, update SQLite, and never delete chunks needed by any version reachable from any head
S11.evidence: Audited GC crash boundaries (gc.intent, gc.unlink, gc.finalization) with subprocess SIGKILL; verified GC marks unreferenced blobs without affecting protected chunks, survives abrupt kills, reconciles interrupted deletions on restart, and satisfies Invariants I10 and I11.

S22.title: Unit, integration, and failure-injection tests; benchmark suites across profiles; test matrix covering crash-recovery, partitions, concurrent conflicts, corrupt chunks, and permission errors
S22.evidence: All 20 Invariants (I01–I20) verified with dedicated named tests. All 20 Scenario Matrix rows audited and verified. Boundary audit covers pre- and post-operation crash boundaries (checkpoints, GC, control resolutions, quarantine/repair) via SIGKILL. Controlled abrupt-reset experiments explicitly distinguish storage/barrier assumptions from process SIGKILL.
